Jet

  • Be my Pawsome Pal Sponsor at $100/month!
  • Gender: Male
  • Age: 10.5 years old
  • Estimated DOB: 01 Jan 2016
  • Categories: Senior
  • HDB Approved: Yes
  • Barktastic Benefactor: Be my Barktastic Benefactor!
  • Child Friendly:
  • Dog Friendly:
  • Cat Friendly:

Personality:

Jet is the last of his siblings still with us, after sadly losing both his brother and sister to cancer during their time in the shelter. When Jet later developed some lumps, we acted quickly to have them removed and tested—thankfully, they were benign, and we could breathe a sigh of relief.

Jet is a gentle, more reserved boy who can be a little nervous around people at first. He does best with slow, patient introductions, and once he feels safe, he allows handling calmly. We believe that in a quiet home environment, where he can build a strong bond with his family, Jet will continue to grow in confidence.

After everything he’s been through, we truly hope Jet will finally get his chance at a loving forever home—one where he can feel safe, secure, and cherished.

If you are keen to sponsor Jet, please fill out the form below!

If you wish to share your home with Jet, please apply here.
